DROP TABLE [BNKM].[SDIAccount]
GO

SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

CREATE TABLE [BNKM].[SDIAccount]
( 
	[SDIAccountId] [bigint]  NOT NULL,
	[CustomerAccountId] [bigint]  NULL,
	[LastSixDigitsRelatedCustomerAccountId] [varchar](255)  NULL,
	[DirectIndicator] [varchar](10)  NULL,
	[RoleId] [varchar](20)  NULL,
	[ProcessingOrgId] [varchar](255)  NULL,
	[IsoCurrencyCode] [VARCHAR](10)  NULL,
	[PayReceiveId] [varchar](22)  NULL,
	[MethodId] [varchar](32)  NULL,
	[FinancialInstitutionId] [varchar](10)  NOT NULL,
	[SourceSystemCode] [varchar](50)  NOT NULL,
	[TaskRunId] [bigint]  NOT NULL,
	[WorkFlowId] [bigint]  NOT NULL,
	[InsertDttm] [datetime]  NOT NULL
)
WITH
(
	DISTRIBUTION = ROUND_ROBIN,
	CLUSTERED COLUMNSTORE INDEX
)
GO
